Messages.Author: Vafudr
Messages.Body:
I could really use some help fine tuning a deck based on the newly printed Humble bundle promo Montano.
I took some old lists and adjusted it a tiny bit, but as I'm unfamiliar with the archetype I'm looking for more feedback and tips om what works in this type of deck. Especially the crypt I would like some feedback on. How much should i value votes when i can snipe my opponents votes with Baltimore purge? How important is it to have fortitude on my other vampires? Also experiences with murmuring of false will in this style of deck would be useful. I'm also quite worried my montano will run out of blood quickly.
Thoughts on the number tuning of all the cards would also be greatly appreciated!

My meta has maybe more combat than usual (both of the intercept and bum rush kind), also a fair share of superstar decks and bruise/low stealth bleeds. Dedicated vote decks are rare, but titled vampires shows up regularly.

Messages.Author: Vafudr
Messages.Body:
Is renewed vigor worth it in your experience? Both the rescue action and the vigor takes an action and has 1 Stealth. The difference as I see it is mainly 2 blood. An I missing anything?

That's great, I'll definitely check out your list hakuron! It's there any changes you would make if you were to take it to a tournament today? Have the recent rules changes or new cards(legioneres ect) affected anything for this archetype?

Thanks for the responses so far!

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Vafudr wrote:
> Is renewed vigor worth it in your experience? Both the rescue action and the vigor takes an action and has 1 Stealth. The difference as I see it is mainly 2 blood. An I missing anything?
>
You can play the Renewed Vigor long before you play the Baltimore Purge. Saving blood is also a good thing but the real strength of the card is that you are guaranteed to leave the torpor region after the Baltimore has triggered.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
